name: Amortized Image Reconstruction (AIR)
definition: A self-supervised feed-forward framework that amortizes iterative Gaussian fitting into a single network pass, eliminating per-image test-time optimization. It reconstructs an image through stage-wise residual Gaussian prediction, progressively predicting additional Gaussian primitives from reconstruction residuals.
summary: Amortized Image Reconstruction is a self-supervised feed-forward framework that reconstructs images into 2D Gaussian primitives in a single pass, eliminating costly per-image iterative optimization.
